name: ModelVariant416_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant416_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x30-byte config at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets the slot parts and packs four texture images before setting up sixteen 0xA8-byte ray records, three webs, two bands and three sheets, otherwise it runs one frame (webs from the config start, sheets and bands from the second threshold at config + 0x20, rays from phase 2) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in the model-180 and model-440 stage-7/8 images of every region except the Spanish four (the Spanish entry is still generated assembly); the French header-433/583 images build it from the same source with palette x 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
